project.name: TableStory Recipe App Rebrand
project.summary: Deliver the recipe-domain foundation, branded mobile journey, TV journey, and proof as five reviewable vertical slices.

tickets.title: Deliver searchable recipe data and API contracts
tickets.spec: Replace the film data foundation with deterministic Recipe and RecipeRail models, recipe lookup/search, rails, and independently testable collection APIs.
acceptance_criteria: The collection contains at least 12 valid recipes
Search covers names, descriptions, category, dietary tags, and ingredients
Recipe lookup, rails, and error responses use recipe-domain fields
qa_evidence: Collection search and lookup API tests
tickets.vertical_outcome: A client can discover valid recipes through the supported collection contract.

tickets.title: Establish the accessible TableStory mobile shell
tickets.spec: Create the TableStory tokens, semantic layout, responsive card system, approved identity, and accessible interaction states without depending on external images.
acceptance_criteria: The initial viewport clearly identifies TableStory
The approved five-color palette and visible focus states are present
The layout has no horizontal scrolling at 375 CSS pixels
tickets.vertical_outcome: A first-time mobile visitor sees a coherent, readable TableStory recipe product shell.

tickets.title: Complete the mobile recipe and My Cookbook journey
tickets.spec: Wire recipe routes, live client search, detail content, and cookbook add/remove behavior through the approved domain and presentation contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Search updates cards without a reload and shows the exact empty state
Recipe detail renders metadata, ingredients, and ordered method
Cookbook controls expose and update their saved state accessibly
tickets.vertical_outcome: A home cook can find a recipe, understand it, and save or remove it from My Cookbook.

tickets.title: Complete the television recipe journey
tickets.spec: Add the four recipe rails, ten-foot detail treatment, spatial focus model, Enter actions, and Escape or Backspace return behavior while preserving TV mode.
acceptance_criteria: The four named rails render and non-cookbook rails contain at least two recipes
Arrow keys and Enter operate browse and detail without a pointer
Focus remains visible and selected content remains on-screen at 1920 by 1080
qa_evidence: TV detail action and return test
tickets.vertical_outcome: A hands-busy viewer can complete the recipe journey with remote-equivalent keys only.

tickets.title: Prove and document the complete domain conversion
tickets.spec: Migrate remaining tests and documentation, remove obsolete film artifacts, and enforce a terminology and end-to-end verification gate from a clean checkout.
acceptance_criteria: README documents mobile and TV startup and verification
Automated checks reject prohibited customer-facing cinema terminology
All configured unit and browser gates pass from a clean checkout
tickets.vertical_outcome: A reviewer can reproduce the rebrand and obtain objective proof that every supported surface is complete.
